request.subject: GRAVE

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the brown soil patch under the headstone so it stands directly on a transparent background with only a tiny tuft of grey-green moss at one side of its foot. Make the engraved skull pale ivory white with cool grey shading. Keep the rounded blue-grey headstone, outline and art style exactly the same.
